name: Dizon 36
description: Sandbox reactive transport model of the Dizon deep well injection experiment (Prommer and Stuyfzand, 2005), built to benchmark mf6rtm (MODFLOW 6 GWT coupled to PhreeqcRM) against PHT3D, and to explore decision-support workflows for reactive transport with machine-learning surrogates. Code is BSD-3-Clause; data and figures in data/ and output/ are CC-BY-4.0.
